clue.text: It is used less commonly for an ointment

definitions.text: It is used less commonly for an ointment

parts.words: It is used less commonly for an ointment
parts.note: the clue simply describes a rarer, more formal word that stands in for a soothing salve or balm

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin-derived word is a literary, rarely used synonym for a salve rubbed on the skin.

clue.text: Cricketing cap?

parts.note: the cricketer who delivers the ball suggests a sportsman, but the headgear named after that word is a hard round felt hat

explanation.definitionFit: A hard round felt hat shares its name with the cricketer who delivers the ball, so it is jokingly a cricketing headpiece.

clue.text: Three different articles, one brought up for the goddess

parts.note: the indefinite article a
the definite article the

indicators.note: in a down clue, the last of the three articles is brought up, read from bottom to top

parts.note: the indefinite article an, used before a vowel

explanation.surface: A grammar puzzle in which three articles are lined up and one is lifted to make a deity's name.
explanation.walkthrough: The three English articles are A, THE and AN; 'one brought up' turns AN into NA in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek deity of wisdom and war, patron of Athens.

clue.text: One in France said this company is not on the Stock Exchange list

definitions.text: not on the Stock Exchange list

parts.note: un is the French word for one
to quote is to repeat what someone said

explanation.surface: A French speaker remarks that this firm has no stock market listing.
explanation.walkthrough: A share that is 'quoted' is listed on the Stock Exchange, so its negative means unlisted; 'this company is' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A company whose shares have no official price on the market is described as lacking a listing.

clue.text: It certainly isn't above-board in the shop

definitions.text: It certainly isn't above-board in the shop

parts.words: It certainly isn't above-board in the shop
parts.note: the idiom for a furtive, illicit sale is read literally as goods kept below the shop's sales top, not above it

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means sold secretly or illegally, and literally describes goods hidden below a shopkeeper's sales top.

clue.text: It needs another three, just the same, to make the circle

definitions.text: It needs another three, just the same, to make the circle

parts.words: It needs another three, just the same, to make the circle
parts.note: a quarter of a round shape needs three identical pieces to complete the whole

explanation.definitionFit: A quarter section of a circle: four equal pieces make the full round.

clue.text: Vital part of the church equipment

definitions.meaning: a body part such as the heart or liver performing a vital function
the large pipe instrument played in churches

explanation.surface: Someone singling out the most important piece of a church's fittings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a bodily part like the liver and the keyboard instrument with pipes found in churches.

clue.text: Go in with one over 50 by way of the canal!

indicators.note: in a down clue, one placed over fifty means the letter for one comes above it

parts.note: to go in is to enter
a means one
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Instructions to enter a waterway, with a cryptic sum of one over fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'canal' is the alimentary canal, the gut, not a waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: Medically, the word describes something taken or given via the intestines or digestive tract.

clue.text: Secret of trendy doctor's model

parts.note: in means fashionable
MO, medical officer, is a doctor; with the possessive it gives MOS
the Model T was the classic Ford car

explanation.definitionFit: Innermost thoughts are the most private and hidden ones.

clue.text: Dose of medicine on fork is full of air!

parts.note: a draught is a dose of liquid medicine
a fork in a road is Y-shaped

explanation.surface: A medicine dose on a fork leaves the patient bloated with wind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' joins the pieces in an across clue; a Y is a fork for its shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A room with cold currents of air blowing through it is called this.

clue.text: High-scoring sweet?

definitions.meaning: the centre of a dartboard, the top-scoring target

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the dartboard centre worth fifty points and a striped British boiled candy.

clue.text: Make a short journey while it isn't raining come to an end

parts.note: a run is a short trip
weather that is not wet is dry

explanation.surface: A suggestion to pop out for a quick trip while the rain holds off.
explanation.definitionFit: A supply that runs out completely, like a well emptying, is exhausted.

clue.text: It is inconceivable that it could be made turn round

indicators.note: turned round suggests the letters of the two preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A claim that something could never be made to turn round.
explanation.definitionFit: Never imagined even in a fantasy, so beyond belief.

clue.text: Pass boy an advertising sheet

parts.note: to hand something is to pass it
Bill is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A request to give a lad a leaflet.
explanation.definitionFit: A printed flyer distributed by hand to promote something.

clue.text: Poor to be on this queue outside a baker's shop?

definitions.text: Poor to be on this queue outside a baker's shop?

parts.words: Poor to be on this queue outside a baker's shop?
parts.note: the idiom for living in poverty is read literally as a line of people waiting for loaves

explanation.definitionFit: Being on it means having barely enough to live on; literally it is a queue for free food.

clue.text: Gave a warning before wise man died

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: Someone cautioned others before a wise old man passed away.
explanation.definitionFit: To foreshadow is to act as a warning sign of something coming.

clue.text: Two turncoats back in charge of the acid

indicators.note: two indicates the piece is used twice in succession
back tells us the word for a turncoat is written in reverse

parts.note: a rat is a turncoat or deserter

explanation.surface: Two defectors return to take control of a chemical.
explanation.definitionFit: A crystalline organic compound found in grapes and used in baking powder.

clue.text: Bill dislikes trusted friend

parts.note: AC, account, is a bill
hates means strongly dislikes

explanation.surface: Someone called Bill dislikes his loyal companion.
explanation.walkthrough: Achates was the faithful companion of Aeneas in Virgil's Aeneid, so his name means a loyal friend.
explanation.definitionFit: The faithful companion of Aeneas in Virgil, whose name became a byword for a loyal comrade.

clue.text: Took a quick look at the way the ball was deflected

definitions.text: the way the ball was deflected
definitions.meaning: in cricket, a ball steered off the bat at an angle, the leg glance stroke

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both peeked briefly and struck off at an angle, as a ball off a bat in cricket.

clue.text: A runner takes it in his stride

definitions.text: A runner takes it in his stride

parts.words: A runner takes it in his stride
parts.note: the idiom for coping calmly is read literally as a hurdler clearing a barrier mid-stride

explanation.definitionFit: A hurdle or barrier in a race is a hindrance that a steeplechaser clears in stride.

clue.text: Drunk seems to be including a herbaceous plant

indicators.note: including means one piece is placed inside another
drunk suggests the letters of the next word are staggered into a new order

explanation.surface: An intoxicated person seems to be sheltering a garden plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drunk' rearranges SEEMS, and 'including' puts A inside that rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical plant grown for its edible seeds used in cooking and oil.

clue.text: In the photograph a rose-coloured beacon can be seen

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A rosy-tinted photo shows a lighthouse.
explanation.walkthrough: The ancient lighthouse at Alexandria gave its name to any lighthouse or signal light.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous lighthouse of Alexandria, hence any lighthouse or signal light.

clue.text: In the mire a tacky lasso

indicators.note: in indicates the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A sticky rope lies in a bog.
explanation.definitionFit: A rope with a running noose used by cowboys, also called a lariat.

clue.text: Settling into home by the heather

parts.note: a nest is a bird's home
ling is a type of heather

explanation.surface: A bird settling into its nest beside the moorland heather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' and 'by' join the pieces; ling is the common heather of British moors.
explanation.definitionFit: Snuggling down comfortably, like a young bird in its nest.

clue.text: Narrow passage reported to be in good order

indicators.note: reported means the word is said aloud to give a different spelling

parts.note: a strait is a narrow channel of water

explanation.surface: A narrow channel is described as being tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: Things put tidy and level are set right.

clue.text: Dance time changed at the end

indicators.note: only the final pair of letters of the time word swap places

parts.note: a minute is a unit of time

explanation.surface: A dance in which the timing is altered at the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed at the end' swaps the last two letters of MINUTE, giving ET in place of TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A stately triple-time ballroom step of the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: I speak maliciously about the inhabitant

parts.note: to slander is to speak maliciously about someone

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to badmouthing a local resident.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is one who lives on an isle; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who lives on an isle is a resident of it.
